## Nixpkgs replacements

Even though [Nixpkgs](https://github.com/nixos/nixpkgs) is currently the **standard** package set for Nix and NixOS, it can be replaced by another with different conventions and/or functionality. An alternative package set may build upon certain aspects of Nixpkgs, but more often than not it serves a distinct purpose.

This is a list of [Nixpkgs](https://github.com/nixos/nixpkgs) alternatives:

- [Nixcrpkgs](https://github.com/DavidEGrayson/nixcrpkgs) Focused on cross-compiling
- [Triton](https://github.com/triton/triton) - [differences between Nixpkgs and Triton](https://triton.github.io/triton/triton-vs-nixos.html)
- [liminix](https://gti.telent.net/dan/liminix) Build Router images with nix, based on nixpkgs
